title: PlayerSignals (for SkyrimNet)
tagline: A configurable nonverbal communication wheel for SkyrimNet.
description: Adds 25 authored nonverbal intent narrations submitted by the PlayerSignals wheel. Requires PlayerSignals.esp, SKSE64, stock-compatible UIExtensions, JContainers with Lua support, and SkyrimNet beta26 or newer. No animation playback, item transfers, or forced NPC responses. In-game compatibility and behavior still require verification.
author: phospheneoverdrive
